# ForAI — Useful Development Resources

> A project-aware resource library for developers and their AI assistants: repositories, SDKs, APIs, libraries, toolchains, MCP servers, and tools, organized by purpose. This file is the machine-readable index; the knowledge lives at the linked primary sources — verify there before relying on any entry.

892 catalog entries · 888 distinct URLs · 89 purpose-based categories.

## Start here

- [README](README.md): overview and the point-your-AI prompt
- [AGENTS](AGENTS.md): the selection workflow an AI should follow when using this library
- [Categories index](categories/README.md): browse by purpose

## Machine-readable full catalog

- [resources.json](resources.json): all entries with category, purpose, source, check date, review level, and HTTP status
- [resources.csv](resources.csv): the same catalog in CSV
